answer: A fresh account starts hollow, carrying near-zero weight no clever fable of self-praise can fill. Standing accrues only as independent peers attest real work over many epochs, so a clone fleet must fund a separate refundable stake bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, and correlated funding lights up like a beacon when the ledger is audited. Faking N identities costs N stakes and N slow seasons, so sybil cost scales linearly.
